title: Eastern Göktürks
capsule: The Eastern Turkic Khaganate emerged from the division of the First Turkic Khaganate around 581-603 AD, ruling Mongolia and the eastern steppe from the Orkhon region. It was conquered by the Tang dynasty under Emperor Taizong in 630 AD, though a Second Turkic Khaganate later revived it (682-744).
